[H1]The Armageddon Counter[\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]The Armageddon counter goes up when bad things happen (cities are razed, The Ashen Veil is founded, an entropy node is built, etc) and down when good things happen (Mardero dies, The Ashen Veil holy city is razed, etc. ). Depending on the civs in the game the Armageddon Counter either rises slowly over the course of the game, or tends to grow to about 20-40 and then levels off (assuming the player doesn't do anything to influence it). The [LINK=GAMEOPTION_NO_GLOBAL_COUNTER]Hallowed Ground[\LINK] eliminates the AC from the game. The [LINK=GAMEOPTION_DOUBLE_GLOBAL_COUNTER]Last Days[\LINK] doubles the rate at which it changes. [PARAGRAPH:2]It affects many things. It controls how many free units are granted by the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_SHEAIM]Sheaim[\LINK] [LINK=BUILDING_PLANAR_GATE]Planar Gates[\LINK], and when various random events will occur. [LINK=CONCEPT_HELL_TERRAIN]Hell Terrain[\LINK] will only spread to [LINK=CIVILIZATION_INFERNAL]Infernal[\LINK] territory until the AC is more than 10, at which point it begins to spread to land owned by players with [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]The Ashen Veil[\LINK] as their State Religion. At 25 it may start spreading to other Evil lands, at 30 to unowned lands, at 50 to Neutral lands, and at 90 even to Good lands. The AC also influence the rate at which units with the [LINK=PROMOTION_UNHOLY_TAINT]Unholy Taint[\LINK], [LINK=PROMOTION_DEMON]Demon[\LINK], [LINK=PROMOTION_POSSESSED]Demon Possessed[\LINK], or [LINK=PROMOTION_KANNAS_WHIP]Kanna's Whip[\LINK] promotions may spread hell terrain to their tiles. [PARAGRAPH:2]If hell is beginning to creep into your lands you have a few options to respond. Sending out some units to sack The Ashen Veil holy city would be an excellent way to get the Armageddon counter under control and to keep hell out of your lands. You could also gift a few powerful units to a player that is at war with the Infernals if you wanted to contribute without getting into the war directly. [PARAGRAPH:2]The Armageddon counter also influences the chance that fire spreads to nearby tiles and the attitude modifier between good and evil civs. There is a promotion called [LINK=PROMOTION_STIGMATA]Stigmata[\LINK] that gives the unit a percentage bonus equal to half the Armageddon counter as well as other mechanics that reward some players (especially the Sheaim) for having a high Armageddon count. [PARAGRAPH:2]Since the alignment attitudes are influenced by the Armageddon count (getting better towards their own alignment and worse towards the opposed alignment) when the Armageddon count gets high huge good vs evil battles tend to break out. [PARAGRAPH:2]Kael's Notes: Functionally the AC serves to bring additional conflict to the end game. In Beyond the Sword Firaxis added espionage and corporations to address late game stagnancy. We were trying to solve the same problem but did it with the AC to try to bring conflict and a sense of urgency to the late game.

[H1]Hell Terrain[\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]Hell Terrain represents the corruption which can spread across Erebus as it falls under the influence of Evil. It is very much tied to the [LINK=CONCEPT_ARMAGEDDON_COUNTER]Armageddon Counter[\LINK], but its effects are local instead of global. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The [LINK=GAMEOPTION_NO_PLOT_COUNTER]No Hell Terrain[\LINK] game option prevents the spread of hell entirely. (The [LINK=FEATURE_HALLOWED_GROUND]Hallowed Ground[\LINK] improvement prevents the spread of hell terrain into the tile, but is only used for scenarios. ) Otherwise, Hell Terrain always spreads quickly into territory held by the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_INFERNAL]Infernals[\LINK], and recedes from territory held by the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_MERCURIANS]Mercurians[\LINK]. If an adjacent tile (or one the other side of a [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_PORTAL]Portal[\LINK] ) is already corrupted, then Hell may spread into lands whose owner has [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]The Ashen Veil[\LINK] as a State Religion when the AC more than 10, into lands held by other Evil leaders once the AC passes 25, into the lands of Neutral leaders once it passes 50, and into the lands of Good leaders once it passes 90. It recedes faster from Good lands, slower from Evil lands, and not at all from lands held by The Ashen Veil. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The appearance of [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_HELLFIRE]Hellfire[\LINK], a [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_NECROTOTEM]Necrototem[\LINK], or [LINK=FEATURE_TORMENTED_SOULS]Tormented Souls[\LINK] on a tile turns it into Hell Terrain instantly, and keeps it that way as long as it remains. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]An [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MANA_ENTROPY]Entropy Node[\LINK] may flair up and turn the surrounding tiles into Hell. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Units with the [LINK=PROMOTION_UNHOLY_TAINT]Unholy Taint[\LINK], [LINK=PROMOTION_DEMON]Demon[\LINK], [LINK=PROMOTION_POSSESSED]Demon Possessed[\LINK], or [LINK=PROMOTION_KANNAS_WHIP]Kanna's Whip[\LINK] promotions may spread it to the tile they occupy regardless of how pure or tainted adjacent tiles are. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Units with the [LINK=PROMOTION_ANGEL]Angel[\LINK], [LINK=PROMOTION_BLESSED]Blessed[\LINK], or [LINK=PROMOTION_CROWN_OF_BRILLANCE]Crown of Brilliance[\LINK] promotions may help to slow or reverse the spread of hell. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The [LINK=SPELL_SANCTIFY]Sanctify[\LINK] spell and the [LINK=BUILDING_CHANCEL_OF_GUARDIANS]Chancel of the Guardians[\LINK] building can instantly heal hell terrain. [PARAGRAPH:2]When hell spreads, the following changes happen:[NEWLINE][LINK=TERRAIN_SNOW]Ice[\LINK] turns to [LINK=TERRAIN_GLACIER]Glaciers of Gloom[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=TERRAIN_TUNDRA]Tundra[\LINK] turns to [LINK=TERRAIN_WASTELAND]Wasteland[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=TERRAIN_PLAINS]Plains[\LINK] turn to [LINK=TERRAIN_FIELDS_OF_PERDITION]Fields of Perdition[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=TERRAIN_GRASS]Grasslands[\LINK] turn to [LINK=BROKEN_LANDS]Broken Lands[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=TERRAIN_DESERT]Desert[\LINK] turn to [LINK=TERRAIN_BURNING_SANDS]Burning Sands[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=TERRAIN_COAST]Coasts[\LINK] turn to [LINK=TERRAIN_SEA_OF_SORROWS]Seas of Sorrows[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=TERRAIN_OCEAN]Oceans[\LINK] turn to [LINK=TERRAIN_OCEAN_OF_DESPAIR]Oceans of Despair[\LINK] [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][LINK=BONUS_WINE]Wine[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=TERRAIN_OCEAN]Oceans[\LINK] turns to [LINK=BONUS_GRAPES_OF_WRATH]Grapes of Wrath[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=BONUS_SHEEP]Sheep[\LINK] and [LINK=BONUS_PIG]Pigs[\LINK] turn to [LINK=BONUS_TOAD]Toads[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=BONUS_HORSE]Horses[\LINK] and [LINK=BONUS_COW]Cows[\LINK] turn to [LINK=BONUS_NIGHTMARE]Nightmares[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=BONUS_COTTON]Cotton[\LINK] and [LINK=BONUS_SILK]Silk[\LINK] turn to [LINK=BONUS_RAZORWEED]Razorweed[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=BONUS_BANANNA]Bananas[\LINK] and [LINK=BONUS_SUGAR]Sugar[\LINK] turn to [LINK=BONUS_GULAGARM]Gulagarm[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=BONUS_MARBLE]Marble[\LINK] turns to [LINK=BONUS_SHEUT_STONE]SHEUT_STONE[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=BONUS_CORN]Corn[\LINK] [LINK=BONUS_WHEAT]Wheat[\LINK] and [LINK=BONUS_RICE]Rice[\LINK] turn to [LINK=IMRPOVEMENT_SNAKE_PILLAR]Snake Pillars[\LINK] [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][LINK=FEATURE_SCRUB]Scrub[\LINK] and [LINK=FEATURE_FLOOD_PLAINS]Flood Plains[\LINK] turn to [LINK=FEATURE_OBSIDIAN_PLAINS]Obsidian Plains[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=FEATURE_FOREST]Forests[\LINK], [LINK=FEATURE_FOREST_ANCIENT]Ancient Forests[\LINK], [LINK=FEATURE_FOREST_NEW]New Forests[\LINK], and [LINK=FEATURE_JUNGLE]Jungles[\LINK], turn to [LINK=FEATURE_FOREST_BURNT]Burnt Forests[\LINK] [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]These changes reverse when hell terrain recedes. Note that in cases where multiple normal resources may turn into the same hell equivalent, such a resource might not revert to the same one it was originally.

[H1]Puppet States[\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]Puppet States can be formed when a civilization with knowledge of how to form Vassal States conquers a city. Puppet States are created as a Vassal of the conquering player, and are the same civilization type as the previous city owner. Puppet States are a special type of vassal in that they don't get a Palace and are permanently a Vassal unless they achieve Legitimacy. A Puppet State achieves Legitimacy when it is the last remaining civ of it's civilization type. At that point it becomes a regular Vassal rather than a Puppet State.

[H1]Revolutions[\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]This game option allows sections of disgruntled empires to rise up together and demand changes or attempt to break away from the motherland. No matter what the source of the complaint, you will be given an option to either ignore the complaint or accept the cities demands. If their demands go unmet and situations deteriorate, the cities may give you an ultimatum and take up arms if you do not comply![PARAGRAPH:2]HOW IT WORKS:[PARAGRAPH:2]This component is intended to add realistic dynamics to the game, making keeping your cities and regions happy more important and challenging. Each city in your empire will have factors that make it want to stay and factors that make it want to rebel. If you cannot find a balance that keeps each of your cities happy, you will face revolts! Revolts come in many different styles, including requests to change civics, requests to change state religion, and demands for independence. No matter what the scenario, you will always be given choices when confronted with a rebellious city.

[H1]Werewolves[\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]The creation of the hero Baron Duin Halfmorn introduces the first werewolf to the world and may start an epidemic of lycanthropy. [PARAGRAPH:1]When any Werewolf kills a unit in combat there is a chance the victim will rise as a Ravenous Werewolf under its killer's control. When another unit kills a Werewolf there is also a chance of the winner becoming a Ravenous Werewolf, although the odds are much lower and it would not change owners in this case. [PARAGRAPH:1]The odds of lycanthropy spreading in combat depend on the relative levels of the two units involved. It is also more likely to spread if the Werewolf is Duin than if a Greater Werewolf, if a Greater Werewolf than if a Blooded Werewolf, and if a Blooded Werewolf than if a Ravenous Werewolf. There is no chance of it spreading to units that are not alive, to Animals, to Beasts, or to units with the Immune to Disease, Werewolf Slaying, or Spirit III promotions. [PARAGRAPH:1]Newborn Ravenous Werewolves are dangerous and unpredictable. They start Enraged and so ignore your commands. Unless their owner also controls the Baron, they will start Rebellious and may eventually become Barbarian units. [PARAGRAPH:1]When a Ravenous Werewolf kills a living unit, its rage is sated and it upgrades to a Blooded Werewolf. Blooded Werewolves have a small chance of upgrading to loyal Greater Werewolves when they kill living units. [PARAGRAPH:1]Units that fall to Lycanthropy keep all their promotions, but loose the ability to cast any spells. If you loose a hero to lycanthropy you will not be able to resurrect him until his werewolf self is killed. [PARAGRAPH:1]Baron Duin Halfmorn has a unique ability to dominate other werewolves, converting them to his owner's control. Victims of Lycanthropy will also become loyal to whoever cured them of their curse, which can only be done through the Spirit III spell Assuage. [PARAGRAPH:2]Kael's Notes: This is a double-win mechanic. Meaning that it rewards players who are already winning, increasing the gap between winning and losing players. Although they are difficult to balance double-win mechanics are useful because they reduce the dull grind of chewing through the players that remain in a game if the player has already won, allowing him to steamroll and achieve victory.

[H1]World Spells[\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]Each civilization was a World Spell they can use. These spells have a huge effect but can only be used once per game so consider carefully before you use them. The following are the world spells for each civilization:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][LINK=LITERAL]Amurites[\LINK] - [LINK=SPELL_ARCANE_LACUNA]Arcane Lacuna[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=LITERAL]Balseraphs[\LINK] - [LINK=SPELL_REVELRY]Revelry[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=LITERAL]Bannor[\LINK] - [LINK=SPELL_RALLY]Rally[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=LITERAL]Calabim[\LINK] - [LINK=SPELL_RIVER_OF_BLOOD]River of Blood[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=LITERAL]Clan of Embers[\LINK] - [LINK=SPELL_FOR_THE_HORDE]For the Horde[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=LITERAL]Doviello[\LINK] - [LINK=SPELL_WILD_HUNT]Wild Hunt[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=LITERAL]Elohim[\LINK] - [LINK=SPELL_SANCTUARY]Sanctuary[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=LITERAL]Grigori[\LINK] - [LINK=SPELL_ARDOR]Ardor[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=LITERAL]Hippus[\LINK] - [LINK=SPELL_WARCRY]Warcry[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=LITERAL]Illians[\LINK] - [LINK=SPELL_STASIS]Stasis[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=LITERAL]Infernal[\LINK] - [LINK=SPELL_HELLFIRE]Hellfire[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=LITERAL]Khazad[\LINK] - [LINK=SPELL_MOTHER_LODE]Mother Lode[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=LITERAL]Kuriotates[\LINK] - [LINK=SPELL_LEGENDS]Legends[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=LITERAL]Lanun[\LINK] - [LINK=SPELL_RAGING_SEAS]Raging Seas[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=LITERAL]Ljosalfar[\LINK] - [LINK=SPELL_MARCH_OF_THE_TREES]March of the Trees[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=LITERAL]Luchuirp[\LINK] - [LINK=SPELL_GIFTS_OF_NANTOSUELTA]Gifts of Nantosuelta[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=LITERAL]Malakim[\LINK] - [LINK=SPELL_RELIGIOUS_FERVOR]Religious Fervor[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=LITERAL]Mercurians[\LINK] - [LINK=SPELL_DIVINE_RETRIBUTION]Divine Retribution[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=LITERAL]Sheaim[\LINK] - [LINK=SPELL_WORLDBREAK]Worldbreak[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=LITERAL]Sidar[\LINK] - [LINK=SPELL_INTO_THE_MIST]Into the Mist[\LINK] [NEWLINE][LINK=LITERAL]Svartalfar[\LINK] - [LINK=SPELL_VEIL_OF_NIGHT]Veil of Night[\LINK] [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]Kael's Notes: We added these for two reasons. Of course they help us differentiate each of the civilizations. But we also wanted to add a strategic option where the player was forced to decide when was the best moment to use the ability. As such all of the World Spells generally grow more powerful over time, rewarding players who don't profit from there use early on.

[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Strategy: The Ljosalfar are a defensive civilization-after all, they can't build any siege weapons. Instead, the Light Elves are capable of effectively mounting a war of attrition, using their forested infrastructure to overwhelm the opponent with units and pillage his lands until he's as good as dead. There are alternative methods as well-getting the Baron from the Feral Bond tech and unleashing a horde of Werewolves is an effective way of taking down enemy cities, and mages always exist. With their ability to build things in forests, the Elves have a good synergy with the Fellowship of the Leaves' forest bonuses-but a Fellowship strategy isn't strictly necessary, and following an aggressive religion like the Undertow will give good early attack units in the form of the Drown.

[ICON_BULLET]Damns livings units to an afterlife in Hell[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Corrupts the unit's tile, slowly transforming it into [LINK=CONCEPT_HELL_TERRAIN]Hell Terrain[\LINK] at a rate dependent on the unit's level and the [LINK=CONCEPT_ARMAGEDDON_COUNTER]Armageddon Counter[\LINK]

Basium's maul is a block of Carcerem bound within rune-inscribed Living Ivory. Living Ivory is a divine metal that heals and repairs itself, as well as helping its bearers heal faster. Carcerem is a crystal that captures and stores souls through Dimensional magic. The Fifth Law of The Compact strictly forbids using this to prevent a soul of any son of Nemed from passing freely into the vault of his god. The runes Basium inscribed on his maul shields mortal souls from being absorbed, but leave both Angels and Demons vunerable. This does not break The Compact as flagrantly as did the Sawol Cavea dagger, which Sabathiel had destroyed, should still be forbidden as once-mortal souls may still be captured after being processed in the heavens or the hells. A summoner of sufficient talent could release myriad demons from the Angelorum Cavea to do her bidding. [PARAGRAPH:4]Basium and the Boiling Sea[PARAGRAPH:2]At the end of the Age of Rebirth, the demon plagued lands of the Fane of Lessers were conquered and the Throne of Hell destroyed. Not content to just cleanse creation, the archangel Basium lead his angelic army into hell to continue his war. [PARAGRAPH]Decades passed and in that time the Bannor used the Crucible to weaken the world's magic. Powerful artifacts of past ages became dusty relics, and those with the talent to be mages in prior ages were rarely able to manifest their power. The Age of Invention had started. [PARAGRAPH]During this age three new goddesses appeared on creation, they were known as the Matronae. Morrigan was the goddess of fate and a great white temple was built to her on the cliffs of the Elohim city of Niveus. From Niveus came the gas Effluvium, which powered city lamp posts and caused divine visions (and would also be used by the Kuriotates to build airships). Sarabride was the goddess of vengeance and her temple was a great foundry built in the reclaimed city of Braduk the Burning. From her city came all sorts of wonders including coal powered trains. The citizens of Braduk built rail systems to connect the major cities of men. The last was Cliodna, the goddess of dreams, and her temple was built on the docks of the Bay of Laurus. From her temple came great steam powered ships that opened up travel to the distant shores of creation. [PARAGRAPH]All three goddesses were active in creation and their religions grew quickly. The religions of ages past, of distant gods who might answer occasional prayers were forgotten, or destroyed by the followers of the Matronae. What use is myth when gods walk among us?[PARAGRAPH]While this was happening Basium's angelic army battled through hell. They fought their way down the frozen slopes of the Throne of Hell, they waged war with frost giants, aquilan and the nive. They pushed through the draining swamps at the mountain's base and past the demonic locusts and the strange things that live beneath those dark pools. They laid siege to the iron city of Dis. Eventually they broke through the walls and Basium called to the citizens. [PARAGRAPH]"You are born of the gods. Do not sacrifice this for trivial rewards. Your immortal soul is worth more than safety, pleasure or power. "[PARAGRAPH]And though most cowered before the archangel, some cast aside their fear and joined him. [PARAGRAPH]Then Basium destroyed the Balor's that guarded the gate at the heart of the iron city. He trapped their souls in his great maul and walked through into the Bloodfield, and his army followed. [PARAGRAPH]Basium's army fought for years in the Bloodfield. And though they were tempted, none of them betrayed him. Yet one by one they died, torn apart by the Tormentors, the Umbral Horrors, the Pit Beasts and the Hell Wyrms. And this was Agares's plan. To draw Basium into hell, where no god could help him. Where he would be beaten, trapped and corrupted. [PARAGRAPH]Eventually Basium stood alone against the demonic hordes of the Bloodfield, countless demons trapped within his maul, his arms straining with the weight of it. It was then that the unholy god Camulos appeared. [PARAGRAPH]Camulos was a mountain of flesh, a creature with parts of a gorilla, snake and vulture. He had a hundred arms and screaming mouths scattered over his giant body. Their locations constantly changed as his flesh twisted, split and reformed. Hundreds of eyes covered him, those of animals and others never seen in creation. Barbed chains wrapped around his body and cut deeply into his skin, causing rivers of blood to pour from him and leaving his skin slick and red as if the spilled blood from every battle on Erebus flowed through him. As hideous as the demonic hordes were, they were nothing but dim reflections of the madness of the dark god of rage and war. [PARAGRAPH]All of Camulos's mouths roared and his roars were echoed by demons across the Bloodfield. He towered over the archangel, and without warning Camulos attacked. [PARAGRAPH]Basium could do little against the fury of a god. Basium was grabbed and pulled, beaten and slammed into the ground. Camulous beat him until Basium's chest collapsed, until his arms broke and his hips were crushed. All while a growing swarm of demons howled in triumph, and bit and tore at the battered archangel. [PARAGRAPH]Until a ring of golden fire sprung up around the broken Basium. Fire so hot it burnt demonic flesh. And even Camulous paused in his attack. [PARAGRAPH]A great rumble was heard across the Bloodfield. The ground shook and everything stopped. A great wave, so large that it dwarfed even the mountainous god, rolled across the Bloodfield, and it crashed down on them. Demons were scattered like dried leaves before the storm, many falling into the pits and ravines of the Bloodfield. Only Basium was unaffected as the golden fire turned all the water that struck it to steam. Camulous was knocked back, shocked and surprised as three masked goddesses flew overhead. [PARAGRAPH]Cliodna summoned up the water again and a dozen long tendrils of water stretched out from her, each with a dragon like face on the end. Together they bit and tore apart any demons that came close. Sarabride floated over the Bloodfield, glowing like a new sun, and cast down javelins of golden fire that destroyed demons and caused the new sea to boil. [PARAGRAPH]Morrigan landed over the broken Basium. She glared up at the raging god of war. [PARAGRAPH]"Come at me. " Morrigan said. "And I will show you that even gods die. "[PARAGRAPH]Camulous charged and Morrigan raised her hand, a stone so black it looked like a hole in creation was set in her palm. Out of it came a beam that consumed all it touched. Even the air of hell was destroyed by the beam. As the air was consumed more air rushed in and was destroyed as well, creating a screeching that grew louder as ebon tendrils and arcs twisted out from the beam. [PARAGRAPH]The beam struck the shoulder of the charging god. Any part the beam touched was simply gone. Not rotted, not burnt, not stabbed but unmade as simply as a candle being put out. [PARAGRAPH]And Camulous fled. [PARAGRAPH]As shocked as the demons were by the mountain sized tidal wave and the appearance of the three goddesses. The sight of Camulous running from battle shocked them even more. Across the Bloodfield demons crawling out of the flooded pits or even those on fire stopped to watch as Camulous disappeared. [PARAGRAPH]Sarabride and Cliodna landed by where Morrigan stood over Basium. [PARAGRAPH]"We have to go. " Cliodna warned. [PARAGRAPH]"We could go deeper. " Sarabride said. But the comment only received disapproving glances from the other two. [PARAGRAPH]Morrigan reached down to pick up Basium. [PARAGRAPH]"Who are you?" Basium asked, though his crushed chest made the words difficult. [PARAGRAPH]"Calm yourself my brother. " Morrigan whispered. "I have you. "[PARAGRAPH]And together the goddesses flew up and out of hell with Basium in their arms. [PARAGRAPH:3]Epilogue[PARAGRAPH]Gosea the Dwindling wandered through the wastes of hell. Once a withdrawn and abused girl in a Sheamic asylum, the voices had drawn her out. They had been the first ones to talk to her, to comfort her and to possess her. They transformed her from a quiet, terrified girl to a fearless summoner and mage. Until a battle on the streets of Bourne the Gleaming forced her to sacrifice those voices, to become once again timid and afraid. To be captured and executed for her crimes. [PARAGRAPH]Which brought her here, to the endless torments of hell. To be hunted and tortured until all mercy was lost, not that Gosea had much to give. [PARAGRAPH]Until a battle waged on the Bloodfield unlike any the eternal battleground had ever seen. In the wake of that battle the Bloodfield was eerily calm. Water still filled the fissures, the sun that briefly lit up the world was gone, blackened earth and burnt demonic corpses lay scattered about. The blood soaked ground showed where Camulos once stood. [PARAGRAPH]It was almost perfectly quiet. Almost. [PARAGRAPH]Gosea could hear whispering voices, so faint she thought it might just be the memories of the voices from the asylum. [PARAGRAPH]Following them lead her slowly through the battlefield. Past the remains of Basium's angelic army, past a shattered gore fiend, to a place where a perfect circle was burnt in the ground. [PARAGRAPH]But the voices weren't from the circle, but a short way off. From a small dip between the rough terrain that was still filled with water. [PARAGRAPH]Gosea waded into the pool. It was dark and muddy with the overturned earth. The water came nearly to her waist and she reached in, feeling rocks and the slick corpses of destroyed demons. But she reached beneath and felt something cool and hard, and in the instant she touched it, the voices flooded her mind with strength, purpose and power. [PARAGRAPH]She lifted the Angelorum Cavea, the great maul of Basium, out of the pool. She could feel the tens of thousands of demons trapped within the weapon. Centuries of demons defeated by Basium. Creatures from the Godswar, armies defeated right here in hell, all held within the rune inscribed weapon. And all available for her to channel.

[ICON_BULLET]The Maul wielded by [LINK=literal]Basium[\LINK] is more than an instrument for slaying [LINK=PROMOTION_DEMON]Demons[\LINK]; it is a cage for Demonic (or [LINK=PROMOTION_ANGEL]Angelic[\LINK]) souls, preventing them from returning to trouble Erebus again. So long as this weapon exists, anyone seeking to [LINK=SPELL_RESURRECTION_GRAVEYARD]Resurrect[\LINK] anyone it has slain must be holding the Angelorum Caveam. [LINK=SPELL_DESTROY_ANGELORUM_CAVEA]Destroying[\LINK] it upon a [LINK=BUILDING_TEMPLE_OF_THE_VEIL]Demons' Altar[\LINK] can bring all of the prisoners back.

Anesidora is the only human soul who isn't descended from Nemed. She was given an immortal soul but without a true divine birthright the ages have worn heavily on her. Though trapped in Arawn's realm since her death early in the Age of Dragons, her cold heart was secreted out of the afterworld in the Age of Rebirth and she now exists as a dark draconic shadow under the sway of her heart's possessor. Though she isn't evil, she is destructive and manifests such sorrow that most enemies fall into despair when confronted by her. [PARAGRAPH]The Heartstone was among the items taken from the Netherworld by The Once-Elves when they escaped from bondage under Laroth and set up their own kingdom in the rift between that world and the world of the living. It was stolen from them and brought into Erebus itself by Gosea the Dwindling. During her escape she passed through a small Illian village called Brigdarrow. Here she was stopped and had her possessions searched due to suspicions that she was involved in the disappearance of three local children, who had actually just stayed out late trying to rescue an injured dog and his elven master. These were the only survivors after she hired three tribes of goblin mercenaries to burn the town and murder everyone who might have witnessed what she was carrying. Led by the elf's map and Auric Ulvin's innate ability to navigate by mana, the children fled through the Whispering Woods and into the Vale of Shadows to take refuge in the Once-Elves' City of Barathrum. There they were captured and imprisoned along with Talia, an elven druidess and witch whom King Haerlond Gosam's chief advisor (Waldrun, a Necromancer secretly in the employ of Laroth) had framed for Gosea's crimes. [PARAGRAPH:3]Mikel Alaunus grew up in a brutal Sheaim orphanage Mikel before fleeing to Bourne the Gleaming. Through devotion and talent Mikel became a soldier and a knight of the Empyrean. His most notable accomplishment was in defeating Gosea the Dwindling. [PARAGRAPH]When the War of the Deadlands began, Mikel was enlisted. He was killed in that war, and raised as an Undead Knight. After the Black Tower fell, Mikel became a leader of Marrowstone, the city of the sentient dead. He recovered the Heartstone from the rubble of the Black Tower and had it set in his breastplate. [PARAGRAPH]During the Age of Invention his daughter, Anna Alaunus came to the Deadlands to purge it. She was saved from the ravages of the mindless dead by Mikel. Mikel argued that the Lilim, the sentient dead, have as much right to "life" as the living, while Anna argued that he dishonors the memory of her father. [PARAGRAPH]In the end, Mikel gave the Heartstone to his daughter and she used it to open the Well of Souls, ending the curse of the Deadlands. But no sooner had it opened, than the Gossamer Legion matched out of it, lead by Ethne the White. [PARAGRAPH]The Lilim were not destroyed when the well was opened, but they ceased growing as those who died in their realm were no longer raised as undead.

[ICON_BULLET]This otherworldly weapon not only strikes strongest against great [LINK=PROMOTION_HERO]heroes[\LINK], but also binds souls to the world from whence it came. This negates its victims' [LINK=PROMOTION_IMMORTAL]immortality[\LINK] and makes it impossible to [LINK=SPELL_RESURRECTION_GRAVEYARD]resurrect[\LINK] them until the sword itself is [LINK=SPELL_DESTROY_NETHER_BLADE]destroyed[\LINK].

[ICON_BULLET]This most feared battleaxe consists of a rather crude blade hafted onto what was once the Matron Essendi, a holy scepter given to the Kings of Old Braduk by the then righteous Goddess Bhall. It is still filled with a remnant of her divine essence, which maintains its holders passion and stamina no matter how long a battle may last.

The Coven of the Black Candle believed Wode made Masks for his fellow members, but he was never in the Coven and never touched a Mask until he stole one from Alexis. Esus impersonated Wode to take his place. The Masks are the Aspects of Esus, seven True Angels whom not even the Compact can stop from working their god's will. No power in creation can detect the identity, read the mind, or compel the actions of whoever wears one. They can all appear in any form, but favor those used by the Coven members who originally wore them.

Os-Gabella fought the Norns and bound their souls in this necklace. It will kill any mortal who touches it. She has occasionally given it as a deadly gift and enjoys when men attempt to touch her neck and brush against it. The wearer can also communicate with the Norns through the necklace, and they with the wearer (assuming they are immortal and aren't killed by it). -- Kael on Reddit
[ICON_BULLET]Warning! Only immortal units, or those immune to Death damage, can survive having this equipment!

A Potion of Restoration is among the most difficult alchemical elixirs to produce. The recipe is long and complex, but also irrelevant. Those who mix these potions may think the power depends on the proper preparation of rare magical ingredients, but in truth all that matters is the alchemist's own Creation affinity. The power has a limited shelf life.

[ICON_BULLET]This sword negates its victims' [LINK=PROMOTION_IMMORTAL]immortality[\LINK] and is guaranteed to kill any unit with the Avatar promotion (regardless of combat results)[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]When The Twenty-One (and their Archangels) assented to The Compact, their oaths were made manifest in this weapon. Mulcarn broke his vow and forfeited his life to this blade, but the word of a god transcends his person and constrains the very essence of his godhood. In his [LINK=literal]Ascension[\LINK], [LINK=UNIT_AURIC_ASCENDED]the Heir of Winter[\LINK] has sentenced himself to death.
[ICON_BULLET]Captures victim's souls to prevent Resurrections or return as Angels or Manes[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]The Compact will not let Angels or Demons use this

[TAB]We marched through the wasteland of Agares' hell. We marched through the razor glass plains of Naraka, past the black waters of the Wraithsea and crossed the Westen Wall, a mountain range so foreboding even the balors gave up rather than follow us across. [PARAGRAPH]In hell we don't age, we don't thirst or hunger. The children at the time of the fall are still young, the few elderly that remain are still old. There is no death here, only torment eternal and the promise of escape. [PARAGRAPH]Sabathiel was the only one who scouted alone, and his trips took him further and further from our lines. In the beginning he scouted for a few hours, but now he was frequently gone for days. Today it was three weeks since the last time we saw him. Hundreds have been disappearing from our camp and I am no longer willing to wait for his return. [PARAGRAPH]"Capria, I suspect they were taken into Duke Eligos' lands. " Thom reported. Though he appeared a seven year old boy Thom had, like all of us, spent the past century in hell. He barely remembered a time before the fall. And he was one of our best scouts. [PARAGRAPH]"Then we will search for them. " I said. "Get Revelin and Donal, tell them to meet us at the gate. "[PARAGRAPH]It wasn't a real gate, we had no time to build walls. But the only place the Bannor were allowed to enter and exit the camp, it was where those entering the camp were blessed and prayed over, to make sure they weren't possessed. Anyone who approached from a different direction was killed. Knowledge of the gate was the first test to prove you were a friend. [PARAGRAPH]Which made the missing Bannor more puzzling. Over the decades we had endured attacks from underground, from the sky, or simply out of the darkness. But to have this many simply disappear. Some while on guard, often whole families and clans. We have never had an attack like this. [PARAGRAPH]Donal looked like a wildman compared to the austere Bannor. His beard was full and untrimmed, his smile jovial and his arms thicker than my legs. We had replaced at least a dozen of his shields, they would be beaten past repair in battle. But still Donal survived. [PARAGRAPH]Revelin had become an accomplished archer, scout and was my most trusted advisor after Sabathiel. [PARAGRAPH]"Has Sabathiel returned?" Revelin asked. [PARAGRAPH]"I'm done waiting for him. " I answered. "This time we will need to save ourselves. "[PARAGRAPH]We received blessing and atonement from the gate wardens, and though Revelin had more faith in his bow than the gods, he accepted the warden's prayer. [PARAGRAPH]Then we were off across the wastes. The ground was rough, with strange cilia just beneath the surface that moved and tensed as we passed, causing the ground to shift unexpectedly. Thom led the way, his knife in his hand and far enough ahead that we could barely see him in the world's perpetual gloom. If he raised his hand, we stopped and crouched to the ground. When he moved we moved with him. He led us as we avoided packs of wandering Dybbuk and Zabulus haunts. [PARAGRAPH]We hid, crept and ran for hours before Thom signaled for us to stop and crept back to us. [PARAGRAPH]"There's what looks to be an empty lake ahead. " Thom said. "All mud and drowned corpses, but no water. In the center there is a ruined tower, maybe twelve stories tall. We are clear to move closer if you would like to see. "[PARAGRAPH]We circled the lake for hours, looking for some way to approach the tower without passing by the hundreds of bodies half submerged in the lake bed. We didn't find on, but we did find the trail of hundreds of people meeting at the lake's shore. We spread out to investigate the tracks. [PARAGRAPH]"I'm not seeing any signs of a struggle. " Donal said, obscuring as many of the tracks as he uncovered as he tamped around the site. [PARAGRAPH]"Me either. " Thom said. "I assume these are the Bannor, but they aren't running, they aren't huddled together, there aren't impressions of them falling or being drug across the ground. "[PARAGRAPH]"There are demon tracks too. " Revelin said. "Harpazein, I think. Maybe they picked the people up here and flew them to the tower. "[PARAGRAPH]"Sounds like we are going after them. " I said. "Take a few minutes to rest, then we will cross the lake. "[PARAGRAPH]We sat at the edge of the lake, counting the bloated corpses, looking for handholds in the tower base that we would have to scale and signs of harpazein or worse flying into or out of the tower. [PARAGRAPH]"Are you taking the Sawol Cavea into the tower?" Revelin asked. [PARAGRAPH]I considered. The dagger hung inside my vest, as it has since I found it. We retrieved it from a Caducus that Sabathiel defeated. The dagger had the power to imprison souls. I used it whenever one of the Bannor couldn't be healed, would suffer forever, or simply wouldn't go on. [PARAGRAPH]"Everyone I trust to hold it is here. " I said. It was one of the reasons I never left the camp with Sabathiel, we could lose any individual life, even my own. But the Sawol Cavea held over six thousand Bannor souls. Souls I would, one day, release on Erebus so they could have a chance at heaven. [PARAGRAPH]"Why does Sabathiel make you carry it?" Donal asked. [PARAGRAPH]"I don't know. " I said. "He refuses to touch it, but I asked him if I shouldn't use it, he always avoids the question. Maybe one of his orders keeps him from interfering, or maybe he doesn't know what should be done with it any more than we do. "[PARAGRAPH]"Do we really need Thom?" Revelin asked. [PARAGRAPH]"You are right. " I said. "Thom, you have already done your part guiding us here. Take the Sawol Cavea back to the camp. Don't let anyone know you have it until Sabathiel returns, then give it him, or whoever he appoints as the new leader. "[PARAGRAPH]But Thom withdrew from the dagger. [PARAGRAPH]"No, I'm not going back without you. " Thom said, his look of determination, and the darkness in his eyes was unnatural on his smooth, small face. [PARAGRAPH]I tried again but it was useless. [PARAGRAPH]"Fine, then let us be quick, and careful. " I said, starting into the lake bed. [PARAGRAPH]The corpses we passed stirred and rose, angered at the interruption. Most got barely past their knees before one or two of us was on them cutting and chopping them back into another temporary sleep. It was a disgusting, gruesome business. Swollen flesh, bodies thick with black water and thin blood. Trudging through knee deep mud and body parts as we inched toward the tower. [PARAGRAPH]But eventually we made the tower, a rocky climb nearly four stories to the tower entrance that was once at the surface of the lake. Thom was easily up the rough wall, and thankfully the jagged rock provided enough handholds that it wasn't difficult for Revelin or I. But Donal was not made for climbing. His thick fingers found little purchase in the rocks, and his boots even less. Eventually the three of us climbed to the top and lowered a rope to help Donal follow behind us. [PARAGRAPH]The tower itself looked like a parapet that had been ripped off of a magnificent palace and stabbed into the center of the empty lake. Crumbling remains of the palace walls still clung to the tower, though they were nearly worn off. All the edges were worn smooth by time. The tower was topped by an open belfry, though it was impossible to see if anything was in it from here. [PARAGRAPH]There was a slight earthen base around the tower, and a few stone steps leading up to open entranceway. [PARAGRAPH]There are no intentional guards or locks in Hell, there is no reason for them. There are no thieves or enemy armies here. If someone more powerful than you wants something, which was rare in the sullen darkness before the fall, they simply took it. If someone less powerful than you wanted something of yours, they weren't fool enough to try to take it, not matter how openly you left it. We were more likely to come across a harpazein delivering a message to Eligos than to find one guarding the tower. [PARAGRAPH]The foyer was vaulted and faded mosaics were barely visible in the canopy, a map of an ancient city dressed in black and gold. The city's streets were laid out in perfect symmetry, and a series of monuments on all the streets directed the attention to the cities center. But that part of the mosaic was missing. [PARAGRAPH]Thom pulled me back a stair that spiraled up to the next level and signaled for me to be quiet. We all held still, somewhere above us something shifted in the darkness. We recognized the distant screeches and flutters of the harpazein, the scratching of imps claws across stone, and something more musical and seductive. A whispered voice, too quiet to be able to tell the words, but alluring. [PARAGRAPH]"Can you boys control yourself if we find a morrigain?" I asked. [PARAGRAPH]"Maybe what's leading the people away from the camp. " Donal said. Then as if realizing he didn't answer my question he added, "No different than any other demon in my mind, cut her down and move on. "[PARAGRAPH]Thom and Revelin nodded their agreement. But just in case I took lead on the stairs up. Let her try to entrance them after I lop her head off. [PARAGRAPH]The towers second level was a single hallway with rooms on each side. At the end of the hall a staircase continued up. There was less light here, in the first level open windows had filtered enough light into the large room, but here the windows were only in the side rooms. A small amount of light trickled out of the side rooms into the hallway, but even our well adjusted eyes were having problems seeing anything in the hall. [PARAGRAPH]After checking the first room was empty, I crept into the first thin shaft of light and signaled for the others to follow. Thom was up with me so quickly and quietly that I nearly stabbed him. Revelin followed, also quietly, he had his bow drawn and ready should the morrigain show herself. Donal lagged behind, making sure he wouldn't give us away. [PARAGRAPH]I checked each room as we passed them. They looked to be old studies, I could see the marks in the walls where bookcases and shelves once hung. The rooms were clear, even without the dust that covered everything in this world. [PARAGRAPH]"Did someone clean these rooms?" I whispered to Thom. [PARAGRAPH]He shrugged, also confused to see the rooms empty, but clean. [PARAGRAPH]When I reached the stairs at the other end of the hall I saw her. She was descending like a queen coming down to a grand ball. I could almost hear the musicians playing, the quiet of the crowd, the focus of the room on her. Her skin was pale and smooth, slight freckles played across her face like constellations in the night sky. And her eyes made the night sky envious. She wore only jewelry, emeralds and amethysts bound by thin gold chains to her perfect form. Though she didn't speak I could hear her voice echoing through the hall, whispers of pleasure, temptation, desire. [PARAGRAPH]Revelin's bow fired and it flickered harmlessly through the morrigain and splintered off the wall behind her. I shook myself, she continued down the stairs, but I realized the trap. [PARAGRAPH]"It's an illusion. " I said turning. [PARAGRAPH]At that Duke Eligos fell out of the shadowed recesses of the ceiling. He was massive, easily as heavy as an ox and he landed directly on Donal, slamming him onto the ground and placing one thick fist over Donal's head. Eligos resembled an ox in more than his size, long flat horns jutted out both sides of his head, his skin was course and reddish-brown, his eyes large and empty. He appeared to be a mix between a musk ox and a deviant child, happy to have cornered an animal to torment. [PARAGRAPH]Donal struggled beneath the duke's weight, but he couldn't move. [PARAGRAPH]Revelin spung his aim around at the duke, but didn't fire. [PARAGRAPH]"You have stolen our people. " I said, inching closer to the Duke. [PARAGRAPH]"I've stolen nothing. " he said, where I expected to see the cold intelligence of a predator in his eyes I saw only juvenile glee. "They came to me willingly, they traded your war for the comforts of my home. "[PARAGRAPH]"Where are they?" I asked. [PARAGRAPH]"I was an angel once. " he said, avoiding my question. "A son of Amathaon, I created the first plum. You have never seen beauty like his gardens. And I lived with others. Now I live with others again. "[PARAGRAPH]"They are not your playthings. "[PARAGRAPH]Eligos snarled at me and put his weight on Donal's head, causing him to howl in pain. I stopped moving. [PARAGRAPH]"I saved them. " Eligos said. "They came to me, begged me to allow them to live in my tower. They are all here, we will create a new garden here. "[PARAGRAPH]"No one came to you. " I said. [PARAGRAPH]"Oh yes, one did. Then he went back to your camp and told them of my offer. And they came, hundreds of them came. "[PARAGRAPH]"Who?" I asked. [PARAGRAPH]The hallway was quiet, Eligos savored the tension, but he was not the one who broke it. [PARAGRAPH]"Capria. " Revelin began. "We have given a century to Sabathiel. How many more should we give? We are trapped in hell, why can't we make the best of our prison?"[PARAGRAPH]I blinked away tears of frustration and pain. When I spoke my voice was calm and emotionless. [PARAGRAPH]"You have been leading the people away from the camp, serving them up to demons?" I said. [PARAGRAPH]Donal's complaints were much more emphatic, "You rutting godless bite. "[PARAGRAPH]Donal struggled and nearly pushed Eligos off of his back. Revelin changed his aim from Eligos to Donal, for a second the demon seemed to be forgotten. Thom used that second to leap on Eligos, easily vaulting himself off the duke's think forearm and stabbing the duke in the chest with his knife. [PARAGRAPH]Eligos caught Thom in his free hand and smiled, the knife blade was half buried in the demon's chest, but it barely pierced his thick, rough skin. [PARAGRAPH]"A mere boy cannot kill me. " Eligos said. [PARAGRAPH]"I am not a mere boy. " Thom said, though he spoke with the voice of angels. [PARAGRAPH]The boy was gone. Sabathiel was held in the demon's hand instead, and the knife was Sabathiel's gleaming sword. Sabathiel shoved it through the demon's chest and Eligos crumbled into fractured pieces of flesh. Sabathiel pulled Donal out from underneath the disgusting pile while I turned on Revelin. [PARAGRAPH]"I'm sorry Capria. " Revelin said. "I am trying to save the Bannor too. I didn't believe Fanum when he said that we would be safe right on the other side of the mountain. There were only more demons there. And I don't believe that story now. We need to find a place where we will be safe, be reasonable. "[PARAGRAPH]"Fanatical opposition is the only reasonable response to the threat of hell. " I had parroted that line many times, sentenced many who would negotiate with demons to death. But none I cared for as much as Revelin. I drew the Sawol Cavea from beneath my breastplate. Sabathiel and Donal watched quietly. [PARAGRAPH]"You aren't the first to claim that. " Revelin begged. "Just leave me here. "[PARAGRAPH]"Though you are willing to doom your immortal soul, I am not. I will carry you out of hell and release your soul on Erebus, then you would have some chance to find peace. "[PARAGRAPH]At that I stabbed him. The effect of the Sawol Cavea was immediate, his features became gaunt and pained. His scream was choked short and his body fell to ash. The dagger felt as warm as fresh blood in my hand. [PARAGRAPH:3]Upon returning to Erebus, Capria personally performed a ceremony to destroy the Sawol Cavea. Sabathiel refused to touch the carcerem blade, as such use of dimensional magic to rob the gods of the souls they are owed violates the 5th Article of the Compact. After the conquest of the Fane, the Bannor would again turn to the use of such magic in order to build the prison of Judicium.

Once Belphegor is vanquished, Basium passes into the Infinite Garden. All the guardians and hosts of the Garden stand aside as the archangel walks to the center of the world, where the Font of Life rests in the Garden's cradle. Sucellus stands watch over the Font. Basium sets down his weapon and asks for Sucellus's permission to take the Font into Creation and resurrect Yggdrasil. Sucellus answers:[PARAGRAPH]"If I gave it, would you lay down power? The ability to resurrect the army that marched into hell with you and every enemy of the fallen? You, who broke the Compact, the laws of your dominion and god? You, the archangel of life that has killed more than any demon? You, who has refused to serve the god of your dominion? Would you return the Adamans Animans so easily?"[PARAGRAPH]Basium simply offers that he will and Sucellus allows him to take the Font of Life from the Infinite Garden and into Creation. [PARAGRAPH]Basium returns to the burnt husk of Yggdrasil and uses the Font of Life to resurrect the tree. Across Creation the effect can be felt as the health of all people, plants and animals improve. Plants bloom, pregnancies sweep all manner of life across creation (many immaculate) and the children born of these pregnancies are gifted with talent, health and life that hasn't been seen since the Age of Magic. [PARAGRAPH]The angel Gwenhwyfar approaches Basium after this miracle, begging him to use the Font to continue to strengthen creation. She warns that Ars Morendi, Buboes, Stephanoes and Yersinia still plague Creation and that the Font can be used to destroy them. [PARAGRAPH]Basium refuses, saying that he must return the Font. But Gwenhwyfar's phoenix lands on the archangel's arm. Basium speaks to the phoenix, then transforms him into the sword Apricus, also known as the Sword of Life, or Demonsbane. Apricus glows brightly and is so powerful lesser demons will be killed by the touch of its light alone. Basium places an arda on Apricus, that it may only be wielded by mortal hands. [PARAGRAPH]Basium leaves Apricus by Yggdrasil, for Gwenhwyfar to watch over (as an angel she can not wield it) and returns to the Infinite Garden where he places the Font of Life back in its cradle.
[ICON_BULLET]Warning! The Bone Circlet attracts hostile Wraiths! Also, if it gets too close to Apophis it will transform the relatively harmless goat back into a world-consuming serpent

The Priests of Kilmorph consider the teeth, horns, and scales of Chthonic Dragons to be sacred. Crafters and enchanters find them invaluable, as they can form tools that can pass through rock almost as easily as the dragons themselves and even help manipulate magnetic fields.
A dreamer will be able to clarify the vision; have them identify the child and allow the Undertow to raise him.
This is a sign that it is time to teach our people to worship properly. Let us recruit a skilled Evangelist at once.
The Lord of Murder has chosen us to be his children. Let us rejoice in the power he grants us over the weak.

Astrologers report that the Shroud has moved into prominence. This constellation is sacred to Arawn and it is said to be a good time to visit gravesites and remember those that have passed on. Although The God of Death himself does nothing to honor this alignment, his archangel Gyra works to make sure that the dead may rest in peace. She hallows the ground so that Necromancers may not disturb them.
Let us honor the Lord of the Otherworld, though he cares not what we do in this life.
Let us be the instrument of mercy that our Lady of Wisdom uses to establish a more enduring peace.
May Nantosuelta teach us to perfect all our arts, especially the art of living virtuously.
There is no need for diplomacy. Let nothing restrain our power to do what we will to whomever we will, even against their will!
Couldn't we just agree that astronomy is a silly superstition, and that we mortals ought to make our own fates?
Bring forth the sacrifices! Let the Firebrands fuel the Sacred Flame with the blood of our enemies, and ignite us with the passion of our mistress!
She's lost her mind, assign a new agriculture advisor.
[NEWLINE][SPACE][SPACE][ICON_BULLET]Allows building [LINK=BUILDING_ACADEMY]Academies[\LINK] without using a Great Sage
Your oldest friend in all the world, the Imp you call Puppy, has a favor to ask. He says that his boss would very much like to meet you. Could we invite this Prince of Hell to our next tea party?
That sounds like a great idea! Do I have time to order a dress big enough to fit a Balor, or will he have to settle for just wearing a nice pink bow?
Gain "Giggles, Prince of Hell," a Balor with the Hero, Strong, Mobility, and Summoner promotions
Sorry, but the table just isn't big enough. The teddy bears have all RSVP'd already, and it would be very rude to uninvite them now. He'll just have to wait his turn.
Dagda apparently believes that our Arcane might threatens the balance of Erebus; he has sent a Runewyn to eliminate the threat.

Men have appeared in our city preaching a most abhorrent blasphemy against all the gods. Our priests attempted to make an example of them by invoking the divine to carry out their public executions, but it went horribly wrong. Only the blasphemers have survived, and their message is spreading.

A new an abhorrent blasphemy against all the gods has arisen. The priests tasked with destroying it have themselves been destroyed, ostensibly by the very divine power they invoked against the condemned. This has fueled the blasphemy to spread like wildfire.

The Lord of the Balors himself appears, resplendent in a dark glory that you can scarcely imagine even a god surpassing. You feel your faith fade as he fills you with despair. He calls you a fool for resisting corruption, for it is inevitable. You ought to instead embrace the darkness, and the power it provides. With Hyborem's favor you may enjoy a long life and then avoid the worst of hell. Without it you are doomed to perish soon, never to escape the torments of Camulos's battlefield. He asks only that you worship him, and give your soul willingly to the King of Hope.
We should use this disease to our advantage against our mortal enemies.
Our channelers have lost control of an ice node. It flared up, altering the weather in the surrounding area.
An Ice node in the %s1_civ_adjective lands has flared up.

Our priests report that a very special vine has begun to grow at the heart of this city's Grove. They believe it to be an offshoot of the that most sacred plant which grows far beneath the heart of the Umbrawood. This shoot is now so weak that it seems unlikely to survive, but with your support they hope to tend it until it matures into a guardian as reliable of that which Sucellus sent to protect the elves of old from the horrors of the Godswar.
By all means, we must guard this sacred growth that it may someday guard us in turn.
To complete your Infernal Pact, you must make a covenant with one of the rulers of Hell. Which Demon Lord do you wish to permit entry into Erebus?

We have discovered a weakness shared by all members of our enemy's race. Some of your advisers suggest teaching our soldiers to exploit this inferiority in combat, but others warn that doing so will provoke animosity from those members of the same race who currently mean us no harm. Should we proceed?

A new sect has begun to gather around ancient bones and pray to the spirit which once animated them. They blaspheme every god and prophesy a day when this great beast will rise again to annihilate all their foes.
Let's encourage these Fanatics. Their Blasphemous Cult could prove useful.
Let's encourage the Cult of Acheron. Fiery Fanatics could prove useful.
Let's encourage the Cult of Abashi. Unholy Fanatics could prove useful.
Let's encourage the Cult of Drifa. Icy Fanatics could prove useful.
Let's encourage the cult of Eurabatres. Creative Fanatics could prove useful.
Let's encourage the Cult of Thalatth. Wet Fanatics could prove useful.
Our Planar Gate has pulled a hostile unit through into our lands.
There are ways of telling whether she is a witch. If. . . she. . . weighs. . . the same as a duck,. . . she's made of wood. And therefore? A witch! We shall use my largest scales!
Executing an innocent to appease the mob would be fine, but this women seems to have some useful talent. We should recruit her and kill her accusers instead.

The followers of Govannon have grown more radical since their master's death. They now demand we require all Mage Guilds to indoctrinate their adepts in Govannon's Ethics. The arcane establishment of course adamantly opposes this, insisting that magic is too dangerous for amateurs to practice.
Who cares what the senile Wizards of the Mage Guilds think? Embracing Govannon's legacy would be great for our military and our economy.
The Mage Guilds are right. Unlicensed lessons must be stopped.
We should just keep looking the other way rather than risk the ire of either the guilds or the common people.
The %s1_playerName empire offers you a Permanent Alliance in appreciation for your service. Do you accept?
Yes, let us rule the world together.
A mercenary recruiter offers his services in %s2_city.
Your %s3_unit wakes from dreams of blood. Aeron, the God of Hate, has chosen him to be his advocate in Erebus.
Grave news! We have reason to believe that Esus has replaced this unit with a changeling!
Why should this trouble us? It is a blessing from our god. Changelings are far more useful to our cause than mere mortals.
By now its victim is surely dead. Justice demands we make this monster pay for the murder.
Pray to Lugus. Only he can compel the creature to reveal where he hid his victim before he escapes back into the shadows of Esus's realm.

A changeling? Seriously? You think such accusations are worth my time? The common folk think everyone is a changeling, but never have a shred of proof to back up their superstitious paranoia. This is worse than a witch-hunt. Why do you bring me tales of such nonsense?
[ICON_BULLET]May cause the unit to become a Barbarian Changeling, or might have no effect
An army of Treants has risen to destroy your Lumbermill and avenge the death of every tree slaughtered by your reckless industry.
The conflicts between the merchants in %s2_city and your capital have escalated. This time the merchants in your capital have hired mercenary raiders to prey on the trade routes of their rival.
A caravan heading to Barathrum has offered to sell us a charm to guide us through the Whispering Woods, and help us establish relations with the Once-Elves of the Hidden City
By all means, accept! We may never get another chance to see the wonders of the liminal realm.

A very hungry Goat has been seen wandering around causing a nuisance, eating several times his body mass without ever getting full. Some claim this could be one of the Unraveling, the greatest demons of Agares. We should be alright though, so long as the Bone Circlet remains at the bottom of the black sea beyond the razor-glass plains of Naraka.
Do nothing, it is best not to anger the Sons of Discord.
An Adjudicator of the Grey Council has emerged, offering to impartially mediate the dispute between %s1_civ_adjective leadership and our nation. This could be a chance for peace.
We do not want peace! Let the Church of Dadga be damned! This war will continue.
Peace would benefit both sides. Give our blessing to this mediator, and may his words prove sharper than their hatreds.
An Adjudicator of the Grey Council has offered to arbitrate our grievance with the %s1_civ_adjective Empire. This opens the door to a possible peace treaty. Do you wish to end the war?
An Adjudicator of the Grey Council has attempted to broker peace between the %s1_civ_adjective and %s3_adjective Empires!

Astrologers report that the Eye of Heaven has moved into prominence. This constellation is sacred to Nantosuelta, the Queen of Bells, Keymaker, and Mother of Knights. The Ring-Givers claim that any skill practiced during this time is sure to improve. Most agree that this the best time to start a marriage.
Those who disturb Ancient Forests may have to deal with Treants rising to defend them.

[LINK=PROMOTION_WINTERBORN]Winterborn[\LINK] units are immune, but other units suffer from Cold damage when they enter a Blizzard. [PARAGRAPH]Blizzards may be created by [LINK=UNIT_AQUILAN]Aquilans[\LINK], [LINK=UNIT_HIGH_PRIEST_OF_WINTER]High Priests of Winter[\LINK], and [LINK=PROJECT_THE_DEEPENING]The Deepening Ritual[\LINK]. [LINK=UNIT_PRIEST_OF_WINTER]Priests of Winter[\LINK] can move Blizzards into adjacent tiles. Blizzards may be removed by the [LINK=SPELL_SCORCH]Scorch[\LINK] spell.

Polar Ice makes a tile impassable and unworkable. It can be removed by the [LINK=SPELL_SCORCH]Scorch[\LINK] spell. spell, but the caster would need to have [LINK=PROMOTION_FLYING]Flying[\LINK] to get to the tile to cast it.

Jungles cause [ICON_UNHEALTHY], but can upgrade to [LINK=FEATURE_FOREST_ANCIENT]Ancient Forests[\LINK] providing [ICON_HEALTHY] with the Fellowship of the Leaves religion. They are also changed to Forests by [LINK=BUILDING_TEMPLE_OF_THE_HAND]Temples of the Hand[\LINK], and return as forests after being burned down.

[ICON_BULLET]Those who disturb Tormented Souls may end up facing [LINK=PROMOTION_CRAZED]Crazed[\LINK] [LINK=UNIT_SPECTRE]Spectres[\LINK]. The [LINK=SPELL_SANCTIFY]Sanctify[\LINK] spell can calm these spirit.
This dummy feature is just here to allow Aqueducts to provide fresh water and allow irrigation

The Hallowed Ground feature stops the spread of [LINK=CONCEPT_HELL_TERRAIN]Hell[\LINK]. It is impassible to most Demons and Undead units. Those who do manage to enter such tiles are stopped in their tracks and hurt by Holy Damage. Undeath spells will not work while on Hallowed Ground. [LINK=UNIT_TOMB]Tomb Wardens[\LINK] may emerge to defend [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_GRAVEYARD]Graveyards[\LINK] on Hallowed Ground. Where the feature is only temporary, their presence extends its duration. Hallowed Ground is most commonly found on Graveyards, where it can be created by the [LINK=SPELL_HALLOW_GRAVEYARD]Hallow Graveyard[\LINK] spell, the [LINK=SPELL_SANCTIFY]Sanctify[\LINK] spell, or Arawn's Constellation event. Such Hallowed Ground is always temporary, reverting after a few turns to the tile's previous feature type. The [LINK=SPELL_ASSUAGE]Assuage[\LINK] spell transforms [LINK=FEATURE_TORMENTED_SOUL]Tormented Souls[\LINK] into Hallowed Ground. The [LINK=SPELL_UNSEAL_WELL]Unseal Well[\LINK] spell creatures permanent Hallowed Ground around [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BRADELINES_WELL]Bradeline's Well[\LINK]

Your unit discovers an ancient artifact, the Whip of the Mistress of Pain. Despite warnings of its evil taint, our conjurers crave the power it would give to their summons.
Your unit discovers an ancient artifact, the Seven League Boots, which will allow a unit to travel much faster and use enemy roads.
Your unit discovers an ancient artifact, a Mask of Esus. Its wearer will always remain invisible, hidden nationality, unable to be captured, and immune to Mind Magic or Death damage.
Your unit discovers an ancient artifact, a Shield of the champion of Dagda. This is a stalwart defense, especially against angels, demons, and the supernatural.

Your unit discovers an ancient artifact, the Sawol Cavea. This carcerem blade captures mortal souls, which technically violates the 5th Article of The Compact. Those killed by this dagger will not return as Angels or Manes. Until this item is destroyed, they cannot be resurrected unless the caster is holding it.

Your unit discovers an artifact, the Aphelion Amulet. This charm was fashioned by Rivanna the Wraith Lord to help her usurp Queen Faeryl Viconia's throne. When activated on Yule, it allows the user to perfectly impersonate a target for a full year. Unfortunately the effect cannot be reversed until the next Yule, which is why the Ljosalfar executed Rivanna in Faeryl's place.
Your unit discovers an ancient artifact, Pelian's Pallium. It is imbued with the Archangel's power but also his pacifism, preventing its wearer from attacking anyone.
Your unit discovers an ancient artifact, the Resounding Shield!
Your unit discovers an ancient artifact, the elven blade called Mist. It is said to phase through metal and stone but strike spirits as if they were flesh.

Your unit discovers an ancient artifact, a Divine Metronome. It beats in harmony with the heart of the Halls of Honor, sending fear into the hearts of chaotic or demonic enemies keeping evil spirits at bay.

Your unit discovers an ancient artifact, the Crown of Akharien! This relic of the ancient Laeran Cord is haunted by the ghost of its last priest, who lingers in the world hoping to restore his faith to its former glory and bring back all of its lost knowledge. Units wearing the crown main gain a mastery of magic that lets Mages learn Affinity. Dropping it in a city will found or spread the new Laeran Cord religion.

Your unit discovers an ancient artifact, the Heron Throne! During the Age of Magic, this throne of brilliant white marble was the seat of Soqed Hozi from which she ruled The Order and judged all the laws of Patia. Legend says that the throne was not crafted by the Patrians, but uncovered by explorers who did not realize its true purpose is imprisoning the spirit of Stephanos, one of the Unravelling whom The Compact forced Agares to lock away.

Your unit discovers an ancient artifact, the Trident of Trenton Majosi. The beasts of the sea still respect the power of the old Aifon archmage, and may be bent to the will of whoever bears his relic.

Your unit discovers an ancient artifact, The Mirror of Wishes. Shortly before the break between the Seelie and Unseelie Courts, Faeryl Viconia acquired the mirror from what she thought was a Luchuirp enchanter but was actually Esus in disguise. The Mirror always shows her an image of Arendel Phaedra, but shows her more beautiful, more perfect and more heroic than she actually is. To others it shows the greatest object of their own envy. Whoever holds the mirror has Shadow Affinity until she sets it down.

Tan'elyn was worn by the Queens Arendel Phaedra and Queen Faeryl Viconia in turn as as symbol of their complete authority of the Summer or Winter Courts over the whole elven nation. Many Elves respect this crown more than either queen who wore it, and may betray their own faction to follow whoever wears it.

We have found the Bone Circlet from the Black Sea beyond razor-glass plains of Naraka! This could be bad. The Wraiths set as guards for the Circlet will try to retrieve it, lest it find its way to Apophis the Endless Hunger and change him from a relatively harmless goat to a world-devouring serpent.

When trying to capture a mature city, bring plenty of siege weapons. You will want to bombard the defenses and to soften up the defenders. If you don't have siege available, fireball-casting mages make a good substitute. Treants and especially Earth Elementals work well too.

Be aware of the strengths and weaknesses of units. For example, Crossbowmen and Longbowmen get a bonus when defending cities, while assassins and marksmen can choose to attack the weakest combat unit in a stack. Phalanxes excel at conquering cites, while Berserkers cause collateral damage.

Consider keeping one unit with the Medic promotion in every large stack-the bonus isn't cumulative, but it can make the difference in keeping an advance going. Disciple class units are the only ones who begin with this promotion, apart from The Grigori Civilization's Grigori medic unique unit. Recon, Arcane, and Disciple units can purchase Medic 1 once you know the Medicine technology.

Watch for announcements about religions being founded and wonders being completed-this can give you a hint as to how advanced your foes are. Should you build the Eyes and Ears network wonder you will be able to see what your rivals research, so long as you are in the Undercouncil.
如果你有国教的话，努力将它传遍全国。有些内政法令比如神化君主和神权政治将为你的国教城市提供好处。

Some religions do not get along very well. The Order has trouble coexisting in the same city with The Undertow or The Ashen Veil. The Empyrean has trouble coexisting in the same city with the Council of Esus or The Ashen Veil. The Children of the One have trouble coexisting with any other religion.
Unlike in normal Fall from Heaven 2, there are no technologies that have state religion prerequisites in Magister Modmod for FfH2

Paladins are special units only available to Good nations and only nations with an Evil alignment can train Eidola. (Unlike in normal Fall from Heaven 2, Druids are not restricted to the Neutral Alignment as they are priests of the Unblemished. ) Alignment is displayed by score and modified by religion.

Mary Morbus, Yersinia, and Sects of the Flies can spread the plague. Sect of the Flies an Infernal unique unit than replaces Champions. Yersinia is a Barbarian hero. Mary Morbus may be given to a player who has built an Alchemy Lab. Units with Death Affinity and either Body Affinity or the Undead race may learn Plague Carrier in order to spread this illness too.

Immortals are reborn in the owner's capital after dying, with all their experience and promotions, but only once per turn. To kill Immortals forever you must kill them twice in a single turn, unless you use the Nether Blade, the Angelorum Cavea, an Angel of Death, or the Soul Shroud.

Units killed by werewolves might become werewolves too. Ravenous Werewolves are hard to control, but become more manageable as well as stronger once they have killed living units. A werewolf keeps the promotions it had before being infected with Lycanthropy, but is not able to cast spells. Assuage, the top level Spirit spell, is the only known cure for Lycanthropy.
The Hero promotion gives the unit 1 XP per turn until it reaches 500 XP. It also gives access to the Heroic Strength and Heroic Defense promotions, and makes the unit immune to becoming rebellious.

Some units can be trained only if you have the required state religion. You can't train Crusaders without the Order religion, and you can't train Satyrs without the Fellowship of the Leaves religion. Radiant Guards usually require The Empyrean and Nightwatches usually require the Council of Esus, but the Overcouncil and the Undercouncil can vote to waive these requirements for their members.

Civilizations with the Organized trait can build Command Posts even without Great Commanders. Other nations must use Great Commanders to construct them. Similarly, the Philosophical trait allows a player to build Academies without sacrificing Great Sages.

Heroes and Apocalypse units are World Units. Each World Unit can be created only once. If such a unit dies, it can not be recreated. It can however be resurrected using the Life 3 spell, which will bring the unit back with its promotions etc intact.
Mages' Fireballs cause collateral damage and can bombard city defenses. The duration of Fireballs will not be affected by the Summoner trait.

Blight will strike all players (except the Infernals) as the Armageddon Counter rises. It gives a large health penalty to every city and damages every unit. You can prepare for the penalty by building health-granting buildings, and not letting your cities grow too large until after it hits. Note that while Blight only hits once, the Pestilence event (which has a similar but smaller health penalty) can occur multiple times.

Never despair in the face of a large stack of units. A Mage's Fireball may not be strong, but it can do a lot of damage to an enemy stack. Other spells can deal damage directly to stacks of any size. A few spells, like Destroy Undead (Greater) or Snowfall (Greater), can even kill whole stacks of the right kinds of units. If you have no mages, use ranged units.
使徒类单位可习得指挥晋升，从而有机会转化其击败的活体敌方单位。指挥 1 需要法典科技与至少 3 级。指挥 2 需要指挥 1、祭司制度科技与至少 4 级。指挥 3 需要指挥 2、宗教律法科技与至少 5 级。指挥 4 需要指挥 3、宗教律法科技、至少 6 级以及绝对秩序国教。朱尼尔法典（绝对秩序的圣祠）为在其所在城市建造的所有使徒授予指挥 1。
所有习得某项创教科技的玩家都将获得一个该宗教的使徒，但只有第一个才享有圣城的裨益与一名免费祭司。
勒约沙尔法与斯瓦塔尔法文明可在森林、远古森林与新生森林之上建造设施而无需将其清除。他们还可使用绽放法术种植新生森林，或在其已改良的地块上助其森林成熟。这对于额外的产能与健康极为有用。库里奥塔特拥有此能力的弱化版本：他们可在新生森林中建造，并施展绽放在已改良地块上种植新生森林，但仍须清除普通森林或远古森林方可在那里建造。
拥有蛮族特性的领袖，无需惧怕那些意图蹂躏其他玩家土地的兽人，尽管他们仍须应付动物。若你决意向蛮族宣战，可随时施展一个法术来实现，但此举不易撤销，且不会消除该特性的研究惩罚。蛮族特性的领袖在探索巢穴时仍需多加小心，因为巢穴可能生成带有隐藏国籍、却依然怀有敌意的单位。

天界军团与地狱军团文明并非凡俗世界之物；你无法以其中任一开局，但若你将它们召入世界，便会获得扮演这些强大文明的选项。地狱军团在恶魔契约仪式完成时进入埃瑞布斯。该仪式每队至多可完成 3 次，每局游戏总计至多 7 次。每完成一次，都会召唤一位随机的恶魔领主，他要么夺取你某个对手境内一座信奉混沌之灰烬的最佳城市的控制权，要么出现于无主之地的一块地狱之火地块上。该仪式将使这位恶魔领主对你产生外交加成、与你缔结防御条约、令他向你所有的敌人宣战，并使你与蛮族国家议和。天界军团可通过建造天界之门奇观、并在其所在城市施展开启天界之门法术引入。巴希姆将作为你永久的盟友加入游戏。若巴希姆单位阵亡，你可在天界之门所在城市使用召唤天界援军能力，以另一支天使大军将他召回。
白手宗教由白手仪式创立，任何伊利安或多维洛玩家均可完成该仪式，但仅限奥里克·尤尔文在场时。将此信仰定为国教，会在奥里克·尤尔文临近飞升时迫使你臣服于他。在那之前，只有伊利安与多维洛能够使用这一国教。
巨龙教团与太一之子不能成为国教。
至高议会政体要求天空的教诲已在某处被创立，且在你的国教为杰斯议会时无法使用。影子议会政体要求杰斯议会已在某处被创立，且在你的国教为天空的教诲时无法使用。两者都会自动让你与同盟成员互设使馆。
太一之子宗教可由神权政体下可能发生的一个随机事件创立，但通常在格利高里习得神秘典籍时创立。其他文明永远无法有意创立它。
布道者晋升允许一个单位向其他城市与单位传播其宗教。更改宗教的祭司会改变他们所能使用的法术。皈依太一之子的祭司会被自动解散。皈依巨龙教团的单位，对不掌控巨龙的领袖出了名地不忠。
维度法术领域晋升为召唤物授予战斗晋升，并允许召唤者保留召唤物一部分的经验值
若你极度依赖魔法，需当心符文温（法则 III 召唤物，也可作为巢穴探索的结果产生）。这些免疫魔法的飞行天使能够在更强单位的堆叠中锁定奥术单位，即便被击败也会移除其全部法术领域晋升。它们的攻击还会移除防御方地块上所有单位的全部法术效果晋升，并摧毁一切须由施法者维护的建筑。它们可无视城市防御，包括守护之环。
多数祭司拥有 2 个法术，其中之一只有在你采用其国教时才能使用
巨龙教团通常在建造火炬红龙阿切隆的城市创立。库里奥塔特的世界法术也能创立该宗教，但通常反而会将圣城迁至其施法之处、向随机城市传播该宗教，并使随机单位成为该教团的布道者。这一宗教为每一条不同的巨龙都设有不同的圣祠。

吸血鬼晋升赋予单位力量加成、治疗加成、对死亡伤害的抗性，以及肢体、精神、阴影与死亡法术领域的使用权。它允许单位吞食你城市的人口以获取经验值。与吸血鬼处于同一堆叠的其他单位可被喂给它以治疗它，若是血畜，则可恢复其攻击与施法的能力。活体单位可在拥有总督府邸的城市中、或从处于同一地块的另一个吸血鬼那里获得吸血鬼这一黑暗天赋。在后一种情形下，新吸血鬼成为年长者的血裔，只要二者皆存于世，便与其血主绑定。（血裔可习得血主所掌握的部分肢体、精神、阴影与死亡法术领域，但仅限血裔在升级时本就有能力购得的那些。血裔死亡时，其血主会如吞食血畜般吞食它的灵魂。）无论哪种方式，若该单位为血族战士则需至少 3 级，否则需 6 级。善良单位无法成为吸血鬼，天空的教诲单位无法成为吸血鬼，天空的教诲祭司法术会伤害附近的任何吸血鬼。在一场吸血仪式中被杀害的首位受害者是兰提斯，太阳神卢古斯的一名秩序使者。光之神因此诅咒吸血鬼，令直射的阳光迫使他们感受自己曾施加于他人的痛苦。阳光对吸血鬼的致命程度不高于对肤色白皙的普通人，却会令他们惊慌而虚弱。请注意，埃瑞布斯的多数吸血鬼其实都是活生生的，并非不死者。他们是精神变态者，吞食他人的灵魂以窃取其力量与青春。一支被流放的血脉背负着另一重诅咒。艾莉柯西丝判处她那忤逆的丈夫永不得吞食活人，于是走投无路的丘瑞尔试图以不死者果腹。成为噬墓者恢复了他的力量，却腐化了他的血肉，因为他吸收了所吞食的每一个孽物的污秽。
邪秽晋升（为法阵祭司与亵渎主教所拥有，且奥术单位可在混沌之灰烬国教下习得）会加快单位获取经验值的速度、授予邪恶之力、导致对神圣伤害的弱点，并使该单位召唤的任何天使化为恶魔。若你与地狱军团某位领袖缔结恶魔契约，你拥有邪秽的单位将获得对那位恶魔领主偏好的能量领域的亲和。拥有此晋升的活体单位在你习得巫术后可召唤小恶魔。此晋升与恶魔种族一样，有助于扩散地狱地形，并招致与巴希姆的外交惩罚。
巴纳克苏斯、秘银魔像与战争机器无法被生命 III 法术复活，但只要你拥有它们的碎片，便可将它们重建。
据说这口无底之井一直向下通到阿劳恩的冥界，那里是不被任何神祇认领的亡魂度过来世之处。很久以前，拉罗斯借这条通道将他那支精灵佣兵大军带入了异界。凯洛林曾宣告环绕这口井的葱郁乐园为圣地，但特布里恩·阿尔班第封闭了此井，将无数疲惫的亡魂困于这个世界，使他们沦为死灵法师的易得猎物，从而玷污了这片区域。

经过农场后，丹安短暂驻足，望向塔奇之塔——一座三层的石塔，似乎没有门，顶层只有一扇窗。那年夏天早些时候，丹安发现了塔的门；塔基处有台阶向下通往它，但村里的大人们在塔的四周堆了足够多的土将它掩埋。他够不到那扇窗，又注意到即便用最狠的力气掷出的石块也只会从玻璃上弹开，于是丹安曾把门挖了出来，试图用一把薄刀撬开门上那三角形的锁。就在他插入刀刃的一刻，一道如闪电般的冲击击中了他。丹安醒来时，发现自己仰面朝天，躺在离塔近十五英尺处，一只鞋被完全震飞。那或许是他一生中最刺激的事件。可他至今仍鼓不起勇气再试一次。至少目前还不敢。——摘自《布里格达罗的灰烬》
